$comment: Explicit, reviewed corrections applied on top of source data. Each patch is logged in status.json. A patch whose 'when' condition no longer matches (e.g. the source fixed it upstream) is skipped automatically and reported as obsolete.

patches.reason: Service WK is marked as running all 7 days, but separate SA (973 trips) and SU (742 trips) services exist, so Saturday would get WK plus SA trains. WK is the Monday-to-Friday timetable.
